parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalisation, border, facility, custody or police-targeting regime is documented, and anti-discrimination and hate-crime protections for gender identity exist on paper. That keeps this well above severe/high-risk anchors. However remedies are documented as slow and rarely concluded, senior officials pathologised homosexuality, parliament removed sexual orientation and gender identity from the constitution, and social polling shows majority hostility to public LGBT presence. The 10-case violence log has no denominator or background rate, so it cannot establish a trans-specific campaign. Net: hostile society with thin recourse, no universal traveller-facing exposure.

entry_documents.protection: No border or document restriction is documented; foreign-passport treatment is not documented.
entry_documents.interaction: No documented interaction with investigation or custody follows from entry.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: No bathroom, facility or ward exclusion is documented.
federal_state_facilities.protection: Anti-discrimination law covers goods, services and health care, but enforcement is uneven.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Paper service protection does not reliably override documented social hostility.

care_services.exposure: A senior health official publicly framed homosexuality as a disorder requiring treatment.
care_services.protection: Health care is within the anti-discrimination law; operative visitor access is not documented.
care_services.interaction: Stigmatising official framing may undermine use of the formal protection.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Parliament removed sexual orientation and gender identity from the constitution after faith-based pressure; opposition figures attacked LGBT school work.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Same-sex conduct and gender expression are not criminalised; hate crimes motivated by gender identity are covered since 2013.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Formal protections coexist with political and institutional hostility, weakening their traveller-facing effect.

minors_guardians.exposure: No traveller-specific minor rule is documented; political hostility targeted LGBT material in schools.
minors_guardians.interaction: A travelling minor faces no documented entry or custody rule, but the school-focused hostility is a climate signal only.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: A local group logged 10 bias-motivated violence cases against trans people in one year, without a background homicide rate for comparison.
street_violence_police_response.protection: Hate-crime coverage exists, but police response and prosecutions are not documented.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Raw count cannot be converted into a trans-specific violence rate or campaign finding.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Only a small minority of linked discrimination cases had concluded after a couple of years; a reprimand came months after the remarks.
remedies_unknowns.protection: The commissioner ruled for a complainant in one mediated film-screening case.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Recourse exists in form but is documented as bureaucratically impeded and slow, reducing protection for a short-stay visitor.

anchor_checks.comparison: Lower risk than 0.35-A: no unremedied universal facility exclusion, birth-sex placement, or state-tolerated targeting is documented, unlike the tier-1 exposure there.

Similar to 0.55-A: no trans-specific offence or systematic targeting, but recurring hostility and incomplete remedies; here remedies are even thinner, offset by no documented visitor-service refusal pattern.

Higher risk than 0.75-C: that anchor has documented community acceptance, enforced compensation and identity-based facilities; this dossier documents majority social hostility and rarely concluded complaints instead.

parsed.synthesis: The combined regime is formally non-criminalising with gender-identity hate-crime and anti-discrimination coverage, but political removal of constitutional protection, official pathologising, majority hostile attitudes and slow complaints make that protection unreliable after outing. No documented universal exposure or organised targeting pushes the rating to high risk, while the absence of documented acceptance and working visitor-facing remedies keeps it below reduced risk. Unknown entry, custody, facility and medication practice remains an open question, not a documented exposure.
